_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Gatus
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Gatus is a status page and health checker for websites, APIs and services, with alerts. Builds Gatus from its source and runs it with the endpoints in config.yaml.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Gatus: Gatus publishes no binaries, so this builds the chosen release
# from its source on GitHub with Go from go.dev (checked against go.dev's
# SHA-256), in a build folder removed when the script ends. config.yaml
# and the history (data/) are never touched; the binary is only replaced
# once the new one is built.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
# Go's module cache is read-only unless built with -modcacherw.
clean() { [ ! -d "$work" ] || { chmod -R u+w "$work"; rm -rf "$work"; }; }
clean && mkdir -p "$work"
trap clean EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Gatus can't be built for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag TwiN/gatus "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 5.38.0, then reinstall."

if [ -x gatus ] && [ "$(cat .gatus-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Gatus $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Gatus $tag's source"
    git -c advice.detachedHead=false clone -q --depth 1 --branch "$tag" https://github.com/TwiN/gatus.git "$work/src" ||
        fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."

    # The newest Go release, which builds every Gatus release.
    go=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 'https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json' |
        jq -r --arg a "$arch" '.[0].files[] | select(.os == "linux" and .arch == $a and .kind == "archive") | "\(.filename) \(.sha256)"') ||
        fail "go.dev can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    read -r file sum <<<"$go"
    echo "Downloading ${file%.linux-*}"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$work/go.tar.gz" "https://go.dev/dl/$file" || fail "The download of Go failed. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$work/go.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "Go's download didn't match go.dev's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$work/go.tar.gz" -C "$work"
    rm -f "$work/go.tar.gz"

    echo "Building Gatus $tag (a few minutes)"
    # Two build jobs and a tighter garbage collector keep the build within
    # about 1 GiB of memory.
    (
        cd "$work/src"
        mkdir -p "$work/tmp"
        export PATH="$work/go/bin:$PATH" GOPATH="$work/gopath" GOCACHE="$work/cache" GOTMPDIR="$work/tmp" GOTOOLCHAIN=local \
            CGO_ENABLED=0 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOGC=50 GOFLAGS="-p=2 -modcacherw"
        go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o "$work/gatus" .
    ) || fail "Gatus didn't build. Reinstall to try again, or choose another version."
    install -m 0755 "$work/gatus" gatus.new
    mv -f gatus.new gatus
    echo "$tag" > .gatus-version
fi

mkdir -p data
# A first configuration: history in SQLite, and one endpoint that checks
# Gatus itself. Add your own endpoints here.
if [ ! -f config.yaml ]; then
    cat > config.yaml <<'YAML'
# Gatus's settings: https://github.com/TwiN/gatus#configuration
# The port comes from the server's settings. Gatus reloads this file when
# it changes.
web:
  address: 0.0.0.0
  port: ${SERVER_PORT}

storage:
  type: sqlite
  path: data/data.db

ui:
  title: Status

endpoints:
  - name: Gatus
    group: self
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/health"
    interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].status == UP"
YAML
    echo "Wrote a first config.yaml."
fi
echo "Installed Gatus $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Gatus version to build, such as 5.38.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much Gatus logs: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR.
